tools.name: book_demo
tools.description: Schedule a 30-minute call with David Uram (founder). Returns the Google Calendar booking URL. Use this when a user wants to talk to a human.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Fetch a specific blog post by slug. Returns metadata and a text summary.

tools.name: get_pricing_summary
tools.description: Return the canonical Customware pricing in structured form (three tiers, no Year-2 renewal).

tools.name: get_scn_page
tools.description: Fetch the full content of a specific SCN / territory page by slug. Returns title, description, category, tags, and a plain-text summary of the body. Use list_scn_pages or search_content to find slugs.

full.description: If true, returns the full body text instead of a summary.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: List Customware blog posts (slug, path, title, description, publishedAt).

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List the main top-level pages on customware.ai (home, pricing, AI Enterprise, demo, surveys, blog, resources, schedule).

tools.name: list_resources
tools.description: List long-form resource articles (slug, path, title, description, category).

tools.name: list_scn_pages
tools.description: List all SCN / SEO landing pages (the deep cluster at root URLs like /salesforce-cpq-end-of-sale, /ai-cpq-software, etc.). Returns slug, path, title, description, category and tags for each. Useful for an agent that wants to recommend a specific deep page to a user.

tools.name: navigate_to
tools.description: Navigate the Customware site to a specific in-app path (e.g. '/pricing', '/aienterprise', '/blog/some-slug', or any SCN page slug like '/salesforce-cpq-end-of-sale'). Use list_pages or search_content first to discover valid paths.

tools.name: open_pricing
tools.description: Open the pricing page. Optionally jump to a specific tier section: 'start' (Use Case Starter), 'cpq' (CPQ Build Foundation), or 'enterprise' (AI Enterprise Adoption).

tools.name: request_demo
tools.description: Open the AI Enterprise Adoption Platform page where a user can request a demo via the lead form.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Full-text search across every Customware page (SCN landing pages, blog posts, resource articles). Returns the top matches with kind, path, title, description, and a snippet.

kind.description: Restrict results to a content kind.

tools.name: start_cpq_survey
tools.description: Start the 2-minute, 7-question CPQ readiness survey. Best for users who want to see if Customware is a fit for their CPQ / quoting workflow.
